notes.session_06_w5: 2026-09-26: Session 06 Wave 5. CombinedNotionAdapter delegates each operation to the API or browser adapter per PLATFORM_COMPATIBILITY.md. reports_unsupported is checked before the call and may route to the other adapter, including for a non-idempotent write, because nothing has been invoked yet. OperationUnsupportedError is raised before any side effect and selects the other adapter only for a read or other idempotent operation. After a non-idempotent write has been invoked, no exception selects the other adapter, including NotImplementedError, its subclasses, and OperationUnsupportedError. A TypeError and an auth-style error propagate and the other adapter is not called. A read or other idempotent operation that raises RuntimeError, ConnectionError, ValueError, KeyError, AttributeError, LookupError, or NotImplementedError propagates that same error, and the other adapter is not called. TypeError and PermissionError on a non-idempotent write, including a browser-preferred write, propagate the same way. When the fallback also fails, the second error is chained from the first. get_public_url is COMBINED: the API delegate returns the public URL and the browser delegate verifies stranger access; None from the API skips the browser, and a failed stranger check returns None. set_view_title_visibility passes database_id, view_id, and visible through unchanged and returns the delegate NotionView. NotionOperationReceipt and NotionOperationReceiptLog are the typed stub from prompt section 4 (job id, operation, workspace, page/database target, pre-state, post-state, provider response, evidence, timestamp, idempotency key, status). Timestamps must be timezone-aware. Status is Success, Unknown, or Failure. A torn trailing line that is not newline-terminated and is not JSON is skipped on load and truncated before the next append, including when several valid lines precede it. An incomplete UTF-8 tail is skipped the same way. A torn tail of deeply nested brackets is skipped rather than raising RecursionError. A complete JSON line with no trailing newline is kept, and a newline is added before the next append. Writers of one resolved path in this process share one lock object and re-read before append. A different path gets a different lock. The lock registry is weak, and each log keeps its lock alive. A str path and a missing parent directory are rejected. Caller mappings are copied before store. Nested mappings, lists, and tuples are frozen at every depth into new containers, so a frozen mapping can be snapshotted again without deepcopy. dataclasses.replace keeps nested pre_state, post_state, and provider_response frozen and equal. Mutating the caller's nested dict and list leaves the receipt unchanged. A caller MappingProxyType, including one nested inside another mapping, is copied into fresh containers. Mutating that inner list leaves the receipt unchanged. A reference cycle raises ValueError. More than 32 levels below the field mapping is rejected (33 nested containers are accepted, counting the field mapping as level 0; 34 are rejected). record() writes pure ASCII, including when a field contains non-ASCII text. A threading.Lock inside state raises ValueError. Mapping keys must be strings at every level. reports_unsupported must return bool. A public URL that is not a string is rejected before the browser runs. NaN and Inf are rejected. Persistence is an injected path only. test_translating_session_keeps_original_playwright_error_as_cause is parametrized over the eight TranslatingBrowserSession methods. notes.session_06_w6: 2026-09-26: Session 06 Wave 6. Formula and schema builders from prompt heading ### 5. Implement formula and schema builders. Reusable in-memory builders return a typed schema for each catalogue kind (Tasks, Events, Habits, Finance, Meals, Notes, Clients, Projects, Content, Invoices), each kind its own record. build_schema copies caller input. Limits: names 1 through 64, properties 1 through 12, select options 1 through 8, exactly one title, property types title, text, number, select, multi_select, date, checkbox, formula, url, and email. generate_notification_dashboard_formulas attaches each formula to one catalogue database and compiles it only against that database's verified property names and types. Session 07 section 4 names a configured buyer name and does not name client_name. That buyer name is deferred to Session 07 and is not emitted, and client_name is not emitted either; that is the simpler faithful option, with no configured text property added this wave. current_date is now() on Tasks. task_open_and_due_today compares the Due calendar day to today. That per-row rename is a justified correction because a formula evaluates per row and the count belongs in a section 6 rollup. birthday_status compares month and day so it recurs yearly. A February 29 birthday matches only on February 29, in leap years and not on February 28 or March 1 in a non-leap year. money_spent_today is this Finance row's amount when its calendar date is today, otherwise 0. Those three use formatDate. equal and subtract remain. water_glasses_remaining is Goal minus Glasses using subtract, and it is omitted when Habits is not verified. A dashboard formula is omitted when its database is not in the verified map, so each personal-only preset generates a dashboard on its own and water glasses are omitted when Habits is absent. A database key that is not in schema_definitions() is rejected and the error names that key and the valid keys. A known database that is simply absent is still skipped, and an empty formula result is not an error. The February 29 test helper compares month-day strings only. The helper does not evaluate the Birthday checkbox. Formula length 5 through 128 with surrounding whitespace rejected so it does not count toward the limit, call depth 1 through 4, result types text, number, checkbox, and date checked against the expression. Formula cycles across properties are rejected. A formula property's result type propagates to formulas that reference it. Names reject surrounding tab, newline, NBSP, and ideographic space, plus U+200B and U+FEFF. Formula number literals are ASCII digits only. Invalid input raises SchemaBuilderError or UnverifiedPropertyNameError. No relations, rollups, views, publishing, adapter calls, or live Notion. Pytest: 1454 collected, 1453 passed, 1 skipped. Baseline collected: 1257 (1256 passed, 1 skipped). Per file: test_schema_builder.py 0 to 60 functions / 0 to 96 collected, test_formulas.py 0 to 68 functions / 0 to 101 collected, remaining files 1257 collected. state_revision 40 to 42 vs base. notes.session_06_w7:
2026-09-26: Session 06 Wave 7. Relation and linked-view helpers from prompt heading ### 6. Implement relation and linked-view helpers. One canonical database per catalogue data type. CanonicalDatabase and CanonicalDatabases reject an unknown data type in __post_init__. Each key must equal its entry data type, data types must not repeat, and the key set must equal data_types. by_type is stored as a copy. Hub views link to that database. Filters are date, category, or status, condition equals, at most 3, and each filter property must exist with a type that fits the dimension. A date filter value must be today, matched exactly, or an ASCII YYYY-MM-DD calendar date. Status values and category values must be options of that property. A date filter on the current_date formula is rejected. Dashboard today view, monthly calendar, and quick notes. The notification dashboard is one row of relations and rollups for Tasks, Events, Finance, and Habits, skipped when that database is absent. The relation must include today's row, and the formula contributes only today's row, so the rollup sum is today's value. water_glasses_remaining subtracts Glasses from Goal only when the Habits Date calendar day is today and is otherwise 0. A hand-built notification dashboard rejects relations that are not a tuple, rollups that are not a tuple, and a rollup that is not a DashboardRollup. Rollup sources must exist on schema_definitions() or as a dashboard formula, and the rollup function must be a known function and must fit the property type. client_name, the configured buyer name, and current_date are not emitted. Carry-forward: names reject U+200C, U+200D, U+2060, and U+00AD at the edges and in the interior; Notion evaluates now() and formatDate in the viewer's local time zone, API reads return UTC, and 'today' can differ near midnight. A formula that references itself raises the formula-cycle error. Pytest: 1558 collected, 1557 passed, 1 skipped. W6 baseline: 1454 collected, 1453 passed, 1 skipped. 2026-09-26: Session 06 Wave 8. Publishing and isolation helpers from prompt heading ### 7. Implement publishing and isolation helpers. A catalogue page is top level, published to the web, duplicate as template is on, and search indexing is off. The secret link is captured. Public access is verified. Page ids, links, and other-catalogue pages are stored as canonical lowercase undashed 32-hex ids, including ids taken from notion.so and single-label notion.site URLs. A plain id is 32 hex, or exactly 8-4-4-4-12. A URL id is the last path segment. Uppercase hex is lowercased. A non-id is rejected. A page that lists itself as another catalogue page is rejected. The same link written three ways is stored once. The secret link rejects a control character, DEL, U+0085, U+200B, a port other than none or 443, an empty port, and a path that is empty after stripping slashes. A malformed URL raises SchemaBuilderError. NotificationDashboard rejects a duplicated relation name, including a non-adjacent duplicate. DashboardRollup.__post_init__ validates name, source, function, data type, and that the source exists and the function fits. The unknown-function check says the function is not allowed. W8 row 1 is the equivalent string clause: re-add isinstance(relations, str) or. The W7 non-ASCII ISO date row is equivalent after deleting _decimal_digits; its site is the ISO date pattern.
